name: Before / After Slider
use: Pairs two native image blocks into a draggable before/after comparison, with a keyboard-accessible handle and a one-time intro nudge.
notes: Over the 8 KB budget (11.0 KB): it is a full ARIA slider (pointer + touch + pen drag, arrow/Home/End keys, aria-valuetext), labels with alt-text mode, lazy-load sync of the after image and a full editor teardown. The after block keeps its grid space while hidden (visibility), so place it where a gap is fine or overlap it on the before block. GIF is 0.71 MB at 1280px/20fps.
